detail: All 2,841 current issue titles/date/IDs were enumerated; only prefixes were printed. Current titles can have been renamed. Canonical issue IDs, not titles, determine the hash order. Initial titles and purpose govern selected-event coding.

REST issue-search responses contain body/state/labels but were programmatically reduced to metadata before display. Full unrelated responses were not committed; their response hashes and public restoration URLs are retained.

The schema probe printed keys and lastEditedAt timestamps of comment nodes before the initial Issue node was identified; no comment bodies or outcome fields were displayed. Initial Issue lacks lastEditedAt, so no unedited-body claim was made.

Two current issue pages (#56094/#58849) were opened for initial-version metadata. The model saw only page titles/navigation starts and filtered opening-date/header lines; current bodies and later comments were withheld. Neither page is counted as recovered first text.

The golang/proposal tree at 83ee2aaf9fdcc1a1cf4bb4d20216fc979635cf04 was enumerated as a possible earliest-blob fallback. Filenames and blob hashes, including out-of-window names, were displayed; no design bodies or acceptance fields were read. It did not set the sample.

The integration worker clarified whole as multi-operation subsystem or complete protocol with integration; confirmed benchmark metadata and Go/WASM bridge boundaries from their initial purpose. This is coding clarification, not proposal acceptance/outcome evidence.
